identity.subject_or_team: CoreLink Release Signing (corelink-cli release signing key) <releases@humangr.com>

access.scope: release-cli/sign-linux signing path; public fingerprint also used by the credentialless dry-run; private key and key ID were read by the disabled one-shot identity audit

blockers: A hosted release run must produce and verify the fingerprint-bound Linux detached-signature receipt against the exact release assets.

identity.chain_or_profile: EV code-signing certificate chain plus RFC 3161 timestamp authority

verification.method: signtool verify /pa /v after signtool RFC 3161 timestamp signing

blockers: Authenticode certificate chain, fingerprint, expiry, secret access review, and a successful timestamped verification receipt are external inputs.

identity.chain_or_profile: Developer ID certificate chain, App Store Connect notary key, and issuer UUID

verification.method: codesign verification plus notarytool and stapler receipts

blockers: Developer ID identity, Team ID, notary issuer/key access, expiry, and a successful notarization/staple receipt are external inputs.
